create_empty_model: create an empty causal LM or vision model from a transformers config with minimal dimensions
set_additional_modules: set embedding, norm, and lm_head modules on a model from a quantized state dict
extract_vision_layers: extract vision layer weights from a vLLM internals object into a HuggingFace state dict
compare_attributes: compare attributes between an original model and a new model and print mismatches
copy_attributes: copy comparable attributes and config dicts from an original model to a new model
